about_the_game:
Four players enter a cursed place. Only those who solve its riddles will escape alive.

In Red Riddles, you and up to three friends step into haunted locations where every corner whispers danger. Blood-written riddles taunt you, monsters prowl the halls, and the clock ticks down toward your final breath. Survive long enough to uncover the demon’s name, rescue teammates buried alive, and race back to the car before the curse claims you all.

Each session is unpredictable: riddles shift, scares strike at random, and monsters adapt to your fear.

🔹 Key Features

  • Co-op Horror Survival – Play solo or with up to 3 friends in tense, first-person horror.

  • Solve Twisted Riddles – Decipher blood-smeared puzzles that reveal the demon’s identity.

  • Buried Alive – When monsters catch you, you’re dragged into a grave. Teammates must dig you out before it’s too late.

  • Relentless Monsters – Ghosts, demons, and worse stalk you based on sound, movement, and mistakes.

  • Dynamic Scares – Randomized riddles, monster behavior, and jump scares keep each run fresh.

  • Haunted Map – Explore eerie houses, a graveyard, and cursed grounds filled with hidden clues.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD RX 570 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti / AMD RX 6600 XT (6 GB VRAM)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Red Riddles is a first-person co-op horror puzzle game for 1–4 players. Search haunted locations, read and solve riddles written on walls, dig up and rescue buried teammates, and avoid monsters that hunt you.
